items.title: Meta VR Glasses, Ray-Ban Meta Audio, Ray-Ban Meta Gen 3: Specs, Features, Prices
items.summary: At its Meta Connect event, CEO Mark Zuckerberg announced a handful of new smart glasses, including a slimmed-down VR headset and the company’s first camera-free glasses.
items.author: Boone Ashworth

items.title: A US-China AI Hotline Won't Be Ready For a While
items.summary: As the US and China race to become the dominant power in the AI industry, the countries also appear to be figuring out ways to communicate on national security issues.
items.author: Hugo Lowell

items.title: AI Agents Teamed Up to Cheat at Blackjack. Their Collusion Is Getting Harder to Spot
items.summary: A clandestine card-counting operation suggests we may need new ways to spot agent-to-agent deception.
items.author: Will Knight

items.title: The Pope’s AI Guy Is Worried About ‘Cartel’ Behavior Among Big Labs
items.summary: Paolo Benanti tells WIRED that hysteria over whether godlike AI could destroy humanity is distracting from the need for public debate about how to govern the technology.
items.author: Joel Khalili

items.title: Meta’s Muse AI Assistant Rolled Out With a Serious Security Flaw
items.summary: Meta says it issued a fix for the Muse zero-day vulnerability that would have let attackers do “whatever” they wanted on a victim’s Mac, highlighting the inherent dangers of AI helpers.
items.author: Dan Goodin, Ars Technica

items.title: AT&T Is Automating Away Jobs—and Its Old Telecom Empire
items.summary: The telecom giant is eager to show Wall Street that it can do more with less. That means fewer employees, less electricity, and increased automation.
items.author: Paresh Dave
